patthana17.9:1.1: kusalaṃ ācayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo na ācayagāmī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā cha.
patthana17.9:2.1: kusalaṃ apacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kusalo na apacayagāmī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana17.9:3.1: abyākataṃ nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paccayā na abyākato na nevācayagāmināpacayagāmī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā pañca. kusalattika sekkhattike nakusalattika nasekkhattikaṃ
